and to recommend the membership of said delegation
as well as to extend, in the name of the Republic

He shall take charge of all the necessary
preparations and, for this purpose, is authorized
to create the necessary committees and to call upon
any department, bureau, , office or agency of the Go-
vernment, including government-owned or controlled
corporations, for such assistance as he may need in
discharging his above duties and functions,
also authorized to progran, budget and disburse such
funds as are assigned for this conference, subject
to the usual accounting and auditing requirements,
and shall make a final report on said conference to
the President within thirty (30) days from the ad-
journment thereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of
September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred
and sixty-six.
(SGD.) FERDINAID D. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) RATAEL M. SALAS
